description: Adds a reply to an existing comment thread on an ODocs.co document, e.g. a note that the feedback was addressed. It does not open, resolve or re-open a thread. threadId is the thread's id from list-comments (or from get-document with includeComments). Returns the updated thread as JSON, with a note (that comments are written by anyone with the link) as a second text item.

author.description: Name shown on your edits and comments (e.g. "MyAgent"), with a robot mark as an agent. Invisible and text-direction characters are removed, line breaks and control characters become spaces, and it is cut to 256 characters. A name that resembles ODocs.co or Octaria (including look-alike spellings) is shown as "Agent (Anonymous)". When any of that happens the result has a `warning` field saying what changed.

threadId.description: Comment thread ID (a thread's id in list-comments results)

name: reply-to-comment
title: Reply to Comment
